description.en: Ubigi is a premium eSIM service operated by Transatel, an NTT Group company, with coverage in 200+ destinations. Strong in Europe and North America, it offers reliable networks, in-car connectivity partnerships and pay-as-you-go or subscription plans.
description.zh: Ubigi 由 NTT 集团旗下的 Transatel 运营，覆盖200+目的地，是高端eSIM服务。在欧洲和北美网络表现尤为出色，支持按量付费或订阅制套餐，并与多家车企合作提供车载连接。

details.en: Ubigi's differentiator is telecom-industry depth: Transatel is a full MVNO operator inside the NTT Group, not a travel-tech startup, and it shows — Ubigi ships preinstalled in cars from Jaguar Land Rover, BMW and others, and its network agreements favour premium carriers in Europe and North America. For travellers, the catalogue mixes day passes (from 500 MB / 1 day), 30-day bundles (1 GB to 50+ GB), regional Europe/USA/Asia packs, and monthly subscription plans (e.g. 10 GB/month recurring) aimed at frequent flyers and expat families — the subscription angle is rare among travel eSIM brands. Installation can start from the car dashboard or the Ubigi app/web account; the same account tops up across countries. Pricing sits in the middle of the pack: not the cheapest per GB, but the network quality in Europe (often multi-carrier) is consistently reported as excellent. Pay-as-you-go credit never expires, which suits occasional travellers who want a set-and-forget eSIM that stays valid between trips.
details.zh: Ubigi 的差异化在电信行业纵深：Transatel 是 NTT 集团内的完整 MVNO 运营商，而非旅行科技创业公司——Ubigi 预装在捷豹路虎、宝马等多家车企的车机里，其网络协议在欧洲与北美倾向优质运营商。面向旅行者的目录混合了日包（500 MB / 1 天起）、30 天流量包（1 GB 到 50+ GB）、欧洲/美国/亚洲区域包，以及面向常旅客与海外家庭的按月订阅（如 10 GB/月自动续费）——订阅制在旅行 eSIM 品牌中相当少见。安装可从车机或 Ubigi App/网页账号开始，同一账号跨国续费通用。价格处于中游：每 GB 不是最便宜，但欧洲的网络质量（常为多运营商）口碑一贯出色。按量付费余额永不过期，适合偶尔出行、希望 eSIM 在两次旅行之间一直可用的人。

bestFor.en: Frequent flyers to Europe/North America, car connectivity users, and travellers who want a never-expiring set-and-forget eSIM or a monthly subscription.
bestFor.zh: 常飞欧洲/北美的旅客、车载连接用户，以及想要“余额永不过期、装一次管很久”或按月订阅的人。

en: Strong coverage in Europe and North America
zh: NTT 集团旗下公司运营
为常旅客提供订阅制套餐
欧洲与北美覆盖表现出色

plansNote.en: Ubigi's per-destination plan grid is large (day passes, 30-day bundles, regional and subscription tiers). Prices change per market — consult ubigi.com for live rates.
plansNote.zh: Ubigi 逐目的地套餐矩阵较大（日包、30 天包、区域包与订阅档）。价格随市场变动，以 ubigi.com 实时价为准。

en: Real MVNO operator (NTT/Transatel) with premium carrier routing
Pay-as-you-go credit never expires between trips
Monthly subscription plans suit frequent travellers
zh: 真正的 MVNO 运营商（NTT/Transatel），优质运营商路由
按量付费余额在行程之间永不过期
按月订阅适合高频出行者
预装于多品牌车机（捷豹、宝马等）

en: App and account UX feel more telecom than travel-tech
Per-GB prices sit mid-pack; budget brands are cheaper
Day passes start at only 500 MB — thin for heavy days
zh: App 与账号体验偏电信风，不如旅行科技品牌顺手
每 GB 价格中游，预算品牌更便宜
日包 500 MB 起步，重度使用的一天不太够
